title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Implementing Ten Systems to Effectively Prevent the Emergence of New Prolonged Detention
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Implementing Ten Systems to Effectively Prevent New Occurrences of Extended Detention

Fa Fa [2003] No. 22

To: All High People's Courts of Provinces, Autonomous Regions, and Municipalities Directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

In order to strictly implement the relevant provisions of the Criminal Procedure Law, realize the working theme of "justice and efficiency" in the People's Courts, firmly establish the concept of justice for the people, effectively improve the quality and efficiency of handling criminal cases, severely combat crime, and respect and protect human rights, after concentrating efforts this year on clearing up cases that have exceeded the trial period and cases of extended detention, all People's Courts at all levels must establish and perfect a judicial work mechanism to strictly prevent extended detention, implement ten systems, and strive to achieve standardization, institutionalization, and legalization in preventing extended detention. This notice is hereby given as follows:

1.  Fully implement a case flow management system centered on trial period management, establish an early warning mechanism for extended detention, and effectively prevent extended detention. When trying cases, People's Courts at all levels shall strictly comply with the provisions of the Criminal Procedure Law regarding trial periods, further implement a case flow management system centered on trial period management, and establish an early warning mechanism for extended detention. For defendants in custody, transfer procedures for custody shall be completed in a timely manner. For cases for which the trial time has reached two-thirds of the statutory trial period, a "Reminder Notice" shall be used to remind the trial division and the presiding judge handling the case. For cases for which the trial time is approaching the statutory trial period, a "Trial Period Warning" shall be sent to the trial division and the presiding judge handling the case.

2.  Implement a system for strictly applying legal measures such as obtaining a guarantor pending trial (bail) and residential surveillance in accordance with the law. People's Courts at all levels must implement a system for strictly applying the provisions of the Criminal Procedure Law regarding obtaining a guarantor pending trial and residential surveillance. For defendants who meet the conditions for obtaining a guarantor pending trial or residential surveillance, such measures shall be adopted in accordance with the law. For defendants charged with negligent crimes or other crimes involving less social danger and who meet the statutory conditions, legal measures such as obtaining a guarantor pending trial or residential surveillance shall be applied in accordance with the law. For defendants who have been in custody beyond the statutory custody period, they shall be released in accordance with the law. If a case in which a defendant is in custody cannot be concluded within the statutory time limit and further trial is necessary, the compulsory measures shall be changed in accordance with the law.

3.  Establish a system for timely notification to inform the detention center of the custody period. Where, based on statutory reasons such as lawful postponement of trial, suspension of trial, or conducting forensic psychiatric evaluation, the People's Court lawfully handles legal procedures to extend the trial period, such time shall not be counted within the trial period. The People's Court shall promptly notify the detention center, the defendant, and his or her family in writing of the above circumstances that are not counted within the trial period, and shall state the reasons for the extension of the trial period. For cases where the People's Procuratorate reviews case files due to a protest or other reasons, the time occupied shall not be counted within the trial period in accordance with the "Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Strictly Implementing the Case Trial Period System" (Fa Shi [2000] No. 29). The People's Court shall promptly notify the detention center, the defendant, and his or her family in writing of the circumstances, and shall state the reasons.

4.  Improve the system of independent adjudication in accordance with the law, and regulate and gradually abolish the practice of internal requests for instructions. In trying criminal cases, People's Courts shall adjudicate independently in accordance with the provisions of the Criminal Procedure Law and adhere to the system of two instances of trial being final. Except for cases involving difficult issues in the application of law, no requests for instructions shall be made to the higher People's Court. The practice of internal requests for instructions shall be regulated and gradually abolished.

5.  Establish a strict system for cases remanded for retrial. In accordance with the provisions of the Criminal Procedure Law and the "Notice of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and the Ministry of Public Security on Strictly Implementing the Criminal Procedure Law and Effectively Correcting and Preventing Extended Detention", when the People's Court of second instance, after trial, finds that the facts in the original judgment are unclear or the evidence is insufficient, it may only render a ruling to quash the original judgment and remand the case to the original People's Court for retrial once. Repeated remands for retrial are strictly prohibited.

6.  Adhere to handling cases according to law; pursue criminal liability according to law if guilty, and resolutely release if innocent. When People's Courts try criminal cases, they shall punish crime according to law, protect human rights, pursue criminal liability according to law if guilty, and resolutely release if innocent. After trial, for cases where the facts are clear, the evidence is reliable and sufficient, and the defendant is found guilty according to law, a guilty verdict shall be rendered. For cases where, after trial, only some criminal facts are clear and the evidence is reliable and sufficient, only those facts and evidence shall be determined and a verdict rendered on them. For cases where, after trial, the evidence is still insufficient, and sufficient evidence cannot be collected within the statutory trial period to find the defendant guilty, a verdict of not guilty due to insufficient evidence and the failure to establish the charged crime shall be resolutely rendered according to law. There shall be no unresolved cases, dubious cases, or delays in rendering judgment.

7.  Improve the system for timely pronouncement of judgment. After a People's Court renders a judgment according to law, it shall promptly pronounce the judgment publicly and serve the execution notice in accordance with legal provisions. The pronouncement and execution shall not be postponed for the purpose of creating a public spectacle.

8.  Establish an efficient system for service and transfer of case files. According to the provisions of the Criminal Procedure Law, statutory time periods do not include travel time. In the course of trial, for cases involving the service of judgment documents or the transfer of case files upon conclusion of a first instance case and entry into the second instance procedure, or upon conclusion of a second instance case and entry into the death penalty review procedure, travel time shall not be counted within the trial period. People's Courts shall actively take various measures to strive to improve the work of service and transfer of case files, minimize the time occupied, make the process more institutionalized and standardized, and shall not cause delays without reason.

9.  Adhere to the monthly reporting system for cases of extended detention, ensuring monthly clearance and monthly settlement. People's Courts shall adhere to the monthly reporting system for cases of extended detention, reporting in writing to the higher People's Court on a monthly basis. The Supreme People's Court shall issue a "Monthly Report on Cases of Extended Detention in Courts Nationwide" on a monthly basis to courts nationwide. Active measures shall be taken to strive for monthly clearance and monthly settlement of cases of extended detention.

10. Strictly implement the system of accountability for extended detention. Anyone who intentionally violates the provisions of the Criminal Procedure Law and the "Notice of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and the Ministry of Public Security on Strictly Implementing the Criminal Procedure Law and Effectively Correcting and Preventing Extended Detention", thereby causing extended detention of a defendant, shall be subject to administrative sanctions or disciplinary sanctions by their unit or the competent superior authority in accordance with relevant provisions. If the conduct constitutes a crime, criminal liability shall be pursued according to law.

November 30, 2003
